tensions: Every position is green or near-flat and every catalyst is confirmed, yet buying power is $7.79 and Fear & Greed jumped 21 points in two sessions. The no-trim mandate maximizes upside capture and simultaneously guarantees we enter any drawdown with zero ammunition. opening.text: BTC $81,591, dominance 58.4%, rejected again at the 60% line. Fear & Greed ripped 50 to 71 in forty-eight hours. That is not the arithmetic of a launch; that is the arithmetic of a crowd arriving late. The book is up 36.4% on deposited capital and there is $7.79 of dry powder. We are fully invested into a sentiment spike.

News flow is genuinely good and that is exactly the problem. INJ went live on Solana via Sunrise yesterday with a record 58.8M staked. ONDO printed +9% on Ondo Network and 70% share of tokenized equities. NEAR tripped its NEAR@3.33 reward snapshot at $70M confidential TVL. Three separate real catalysts in one week. When every thesis is working simultaneously, you are not being smart, you are being long beta.

No SELL triggers fire. Nothing is down more than 15%, nothing is fourteen-day dead money, dominance is under 60. Mandate says no trimming, so we hold all eight. ARB is the ugly one: minus 5.4% two days in, the 92.6M unlock already landed Sep 16, and the Robinhood Chain gas subsidy that IS the entire thesis expires in about ten days. Watch the fee data, not the chart.

ZEC has run from $1,049 to $1,519 on ETF inflows and a privacy-as-insurance story. It is up 45% and we are told to hold for 100x. Fine. But understand the trade we are actually in: eight correlated altcoin longs, zero cash, a BTC that must defend $80K, and no ability to buy a dip if it comes. The upside is real. The absence of optionality is also real.
